lead: Digvijaya Singh is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 28 February 1947 in Indore.
As of 2026, he is 79 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh and Member of the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly.

sections.heading: Digvijaya Singh — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Digvijaya Singh was born on 28 February 1947 in Indore, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Balbhadra Singh.
He studied at Shri Govindram Seksaria Institute of Technology and Science.

sections.heading: Digvijaya Singh — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh (1993–2003), Member of the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly, member of Rajya Sabha and Member of the 8th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.

sections.heading: Digvijaya Singh — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Amrita Rai (married 2015).
He is a parent to Jaivardhan Singh.
